name: Cheerful Tune
source: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
description: A cheerful, wordless tune fills the room, compelling everyone to get to work.
disable: DC 20 Religion check (trained) to exorcise the spirits, or DC 21 Intimidation check to convince the spirits it is time to take a break; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
reset: The ghostly workers cease their routine 2 rounds after all living creatures leave the room and reset after 6 hours.
routine: (3 actions) Ghostly workers appear in the room and begin abrading, scrubbing, and splashing cleaning chemicals on anyone in the area. Each creature in the room takes 1d4+2 slashing and 1d4+2 acid damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save; roll once for both).

offensiveAbilities.name: Nose to the Grindstone
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the smiling face in the center of the north wall

Effect The whistling rises in volume to a painful pitch and deals 1d8+4 sonic damage. The affected creature must attempt a DC 20 Will save, and the haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Deafened for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is Frightened 1, and is deafened for 2 minutes.
